title: Incidence of Reports from Theft Victims that Their Belongings Are Sold at Second-hand and Pawnshops
what_it_is: Incidence of Reports from Theft Victims that Their Belongings Are Sold at Second-hand and Pawnshops

sections.label: Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers rules
sections.summary: MHA does not track theft reports of goods sold in second-hand shops or pawnshops, which are regulated under the SHGDA and PBA.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Home Affairs does not track the number of reports from theft victims of their belongings being sold in second-hand shops or pawnshops.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Second-hand goods dealers and pawnbrokers today are regulated under the Second-hand Goods Dealers Act (SHGDA) and the Pawnbrokers Act (PBA) respectively unless they meet certain exemption criteria or are granted a waiver.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Under these regimes, they are required to take reasonable steps to satisfy themselves that the goods that they transact in are not stolen or obtained through fraudulent or dishonest means.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In the event that any item is found to have been reported stolen or lost, the second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers are expected to detain the item and make a Police report without undue delay.

sections.label: Court order returns item
sections.summary: After investigations conclude, Police will seek a Court order to return the item to the victim.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Upon the conclusion of investigations, Police will seek an order from the Court to return the item to the victim.

sections.label: Chain operators centralised database
sections.summary: Chain operators have a centralised information database for sharing information and profiling customers, and the Pawnbrokers Act requires reasonable steps on goods.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: Specific to her question, today, chain operators already have a centralised information database, precisely for the purpose that the Member mentioned, for the sharing of information and to profile their customers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: As I have mentioned earlier in my main reply, the Pawnbrokers Act requires pawnbrokers to take reasonable steps to ensure that the goods they deal in are not stolen or obtained through fraudulent or dishonest means.

sections.label: Reporting to Police or Registry
sections.summary: Members of the public in these situations can report to the Police or lodge complaints with the Registry of Pawnbrokers for investigations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: Members of the public who find themselves in these situations can then report these to the Police or lodge complaints with the Registry of Pawnbrokers under the Ministry of Law so that investigations can take place.
